input: Sign up for a beginner's glassblowing workshop nearby

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Nearby Beginner Glassblowing Workshop
gold.taskDescription: Find and register for a beginner-level glassblowing workshop at a local studio or venue.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search center on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location or preferred search area to find nearby workshops.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or timeframe in mind?
questions.description: Determine when the user wants to attend — a specific date, month, or general window.

questions.title: Are you signing up solo or bringing other people?
questions.description: Find out how many spots need to be reserved at the workshop.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget for the workshop fee?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter out workshops that are too costly.

questions.title: Do you prefer a weekday, weekend, or evening session?
questions.description: Narrow down scheduling options based on the user's availability.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the studio?
questions.description: Set a maximum distance or travel time so only truly nearby options are considered.

questions.title: Is there a specific item you want to make in the class?
questions.description: Some workshops focus on specific projects like ornaments, vessels, or free-form pieces — knowing this helps match the right class.
